name: io.github.kashmirsportslive/pulse-leads-mcp
title: PulseLeads MCP
description: High-intent B2B prospect intelligence MCP server with verified contacts & Base USDC billing.

tools.name: find_b2b_prospects
tools.description: Search and filter multiple high-intent B2B companies by industry and buying intent score. Returns company domains, decision-maker titles, verified email patterns, tech stacks, and hiring triggers. Use get_company_intelligence instead when looking up one specific company or domain.

apiKey.description: Active PulseLeads API key. Use 'demo_free_key' for evaluation (5 queries/24h per IP), or a purchased key.

industry.description: Industry keyword filter (e.g. 'AI', 'Fintech', 'Real Estate', 'PropTech', 'HealthTech', 'Cybersecurity', 'SaaS'). Leave empty for all industries.

minIntentScore.description: Minimum buying intent score from 0 to 100 (default: 80).

tools.name: check_account_credits
tools.description: Check remaining query credits, active subscription tier, and top-up checkout URL for an existing PulseLeads API key.

apiKey.description: Existing PulseLeads API key to inspect.

tools.name: get_company_intelligence
tools.description: Look up intelligence for one specific company name or domain. Returns decision-maker name/title, direct or pattern email, LinkedIn search URL, tech stack, and hiring triggers. Use find_b2b_prospects instead to browse companies by industry.

apiKey.description: Active PulseLeads API key (e.g. 'demo_free_key' or a purchased key).

companyOrDomain.description: Exact company name or domain to look up (e.g. 'anthropic.com', 'Vercel', 'cloudscale.ai').

tools.name: get_pricing_and_checkout
tools.description: Retrieve PulseLeads pricing tiers (Free Trial, Starter $9, Pro $19, Growth $29), checkout links, and Base Mainnet USDC payment instructions. No API key required.

plan.description: Optional plan filter ('trial', 'starter', 'pro', or 'growth'). Omit to return all plans.

tools.name: verify_usdc_payment
tools.description: Verify a confirmed Base Mainnet (EVM 8453) USDC transaction hash on-chain and immediately provision an active PulseLeads API key with matching credits.

txHash.description: 66-character Base Mainnet transaction hash starting with 0x.

plan.description: Purchased plan tier: 'starter' ($9 / 500 credits), 'pro' ($19 / 1500 credits), or 'growth' ($29 / 3000 credits).

email.description: Optional work email address for payment receipt tracking.

tools.name: export_leads_csv
tools.description: Export matching high-intent B2B leads with MX deliverability status and personalized outreach hooks as a CRM-ready CSV string (HubSpot/Salesforce/Sheets compatible). Use find_b2b_prospects instead for JSON output.

apiKey.description: Active PulseLeads API key (e.g. 'demo_free_key' or a purchased key).

minIntentScore.description: Minimum buying intent score from 0 to 100 (default: 80).
